rent.notes: Como province Oct 2026 asking rents: apartments avg EUR 155/m2/yr (3-room 1,115, 4-room 1,445), houses EUR 220/m2/yr; Numbeo Como 3BR outside centre ~EUR 1,180-1,200, centre ~1,650. Pet-friendly 2-3BR with garden skews toward the upper half; registration tax/agency fee amortized.

utilities.notes: Energy spike in late 2026: ARERA vulnerable-customer electricity 43.43 c/kWh from Oct 1 2026 (+37.3% q/q) and gas reference 1.768 EUR/Smc (Oct 2026). Model: ~2,700 kWh/yr electricity (~EUR 90/mo) + ~1,200 Smc gas heating in a pre-Alpine climate (~EUR 175/mo) + water and TARI (~EUR 60/mo; TARI national avg EUR 350/yr). Numbeo Como basic utilities EUR 205-236/mo predates the Q4 increase. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Elective-residence retirees register voluntarily with the SSN: 7.5% of worldwide income up to EUR 20,658 plus 4% up to EUR 51,646, with a EUR 2,000/yr minimum and EUR 2,789 max per person; for this household roughly EUR 2,000-2,100 each = ~EUR 335-345/mo for two (Constitutional Court 97/2026 did not strike the minimum). Typical adds a basic Italian supplementary policy (EUR 800-2,000/yr per policy); max = SSN plus intermediate private cover for both.

healthcare.system: Italian SSN. Proximity to Milan (1-1.5 hours) gives access to world-class hospitals. Local hospitals adequate for routine care.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 3-10 weeks. Milan private options easily accessible.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: SSN covers essential prescriptions with tiered co-pays

pros: Close to Milan and Swiss border for shopping and travel
Mild microclimate (warmer than surrounding areas due to lakes)

cons.text: Higher cost of living than southern Italy
